findings.code_snippet:
node scripts/assemble-agent-marketplace.mjs sync '\\server\share\agents\marketplace'
```

The script does not establish network credentials, map a drive, or change share permissions. For recognized filesystem errors, it preserves the error code and adds recovery guidance with public-safe display paths (`~` or `[external]/<name>`). These display paths identify the selected location but are not replacement command arguments. It does not redirect output or retry indefinitely; reconcile the destination before retrying as described below.

Treat the Marketplace as a single-writer-at-a-time destination. The direct assembler does not acquire a writer lock; serialization must come from the caller or orchestrator. Do not run `init`, `add`, or direct assembler `sync` commands concurrently against the same root. A higher-level multi-contributor workflow may serialize writers with a Marketplace-owned lock and use scoped merge operations, but different plugins do not make concurrent catalog or stat
findings.message: Skill allows unbounded resource consumption (API calls, storage, compute). Without rate limits or quotas, a compromised or misbehaving agent can cause denial-of-service or cost overruns.
findings.remediation: Set explicit rate limits, timeouts, and resource quotas for API calls, file operations, and compute. Implement circuit breakers for runaway loops.
